assessment.cause: The topology localizer found the indentation, but defined the red center as the midpoint of two threshold-dependent mouth-return points. Asymmetric mouth shoulders displaced that midpoint from the physical notch axis/deepest tip.
assessment.prevention: Use the deepest point of the topology-derived indentation profile as the red notch axis/center. Preserve the two mouth-return points only as yellow width bounds and retain the midpoint as a diagnostic field.
